metadata.title: Reliability and Generalization in UAV Crop-Weed Mapping: A Scoping Review

epistemology.unit_of_analysis: Primary empirical UAV crop-weed mapping studies and dataset/benchmark reports; linked versions form one study/report family.
epistemology.trustworthiness_framework: Transparent scoping evidence map with PRISMA-ScR reporting; protocol-specific provenance and evaluation-design charting.
epistemology.epistemological_rationale: Descriptive evidence mapping combines structured counts with qualitative comparison of evaluation designs; it does not estimate pooled causal effects or assume generalization from reported accuracy.

research_questions.text: How do UAV crop-weed mapping studies define and evaluate reliability under spectral degradation, sensor differences, and temporal shift?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Descriptive evidence map and narrative comparison
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Primary empirical study or dataset/benchmark report with source-linked methods

research_questions.text: Which datasets, sensors, dates, fields, and split units support the reported generalization claims?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Descriptive evidence map and narrative comparison
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Primary empirical study or dataset/benchmark report with source-linked methods

research_questions.text: How are uncertainty, calibration, missing evidence, and failed transfer reported?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Descriptive evidence map and narrative comparison
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Primary empirical study or dataset/benchmark report with source-linked methods

research_questions.text: Which evidence gaps remain after separating dataset diversity, model mechanisms, and demonstrated external validation?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Descriptive evidence map and narrative comparison
research_questions.required_evidence_type: Primary empirical study or dataset/benchmark report with source-linked methods

inclusion.criterion: Uses UAV-acquired imagery for crop/weed detection, segmentation, or spatial weed mapping in an agricultural field context; UAV results must be separable in mixed-platform studies.

Primary empirical method study or dataset/benchmark report with sufficient accessible methods to chart the task and acquisition/evaluation design; journal, conference, and substantive preprint reports are eligible.

Published from 2020 through the recorded final search cutoff, inclusive; English full text in the provisional scope. Older foundational sources remain background unless a logged amendment expands eligibility.

exclusion.criterion: Satellite-only, ground-robot-only, handheld, or laboratory imaging with no separable eligible UAV mapping evidence.
UAV navigation/SLAM, yield, disease, phenotyping, or non-agricultural mapping without a separable crop/weed localization or mapping task.
Review, editorial, commentary, protocol-only report or abstract-only record lacking a substantive primary methods report; retain useful reviews as background.
Outside the frozen publication date or language scope after bibliographic/full-text verification.

matrix_dimensions.name: Study Reports
matrix_dimensions.description: Study identity, all linked report versions, publication/preprint status and publication dates.

matrix_dimensions.name: Task Context
matrix_dimensions.description: Crop, weed classes, field context, mapping/detection/segmentation task; separate non-UAV components.

matrix_dimensions.name: Dataset Units
matrix_dimensions.description: Datasets, unique fields/orthomosaics/flights/dates/seasons, tiles; independent units versus image count.

matrix_dimensions.name: Sensor Inputs
matrix_dimensions.description: Sensor/platform, physical bands, spectral response and resolution, sensor metadata actually used.

matrix_dimensions.name: Availability Alignment
matrix_dimensions.description: Missing/degraded bands, misregistration/noise/illumination; synthetic versus naturally observed stress.

matrix_dimensions.name: Temporal Design
matrix_dimensions.description: Multiple acquisition dates versus time-series modeling versus held-out date/season testing.

matrix_dimensions.name: Split Protocol
matrix_dimensions.description: Train/validation/test grouping, overlap risk, held-out fields/sensors/seasons and target-data use.

matrix_dimensions.name: Fusion Mechanism
matrix_dimensions.description: Fusion/gating/metadata conditioning and matched controls; mechanism claims versus tested interventions.

matrix_dimensions.name: Uncertainty Calibration
matrix_dimensions.description: Uncertainty method, calibration metrics, test conditions, abstention; learned weights are not calibration.

matrix_dimensions.name: Metrics Comparators
matrix_dimensions.description: Class-specific metrics, controls, seeds, independent uncertainty units; no cross-dataset ranking.

matrix_dimensions.name: Transfer Outcomes
matrix_dimensions.description: In-domain, cross-field/date/sensor outcomes; adaptation versus direct transfer; preserve failures.

matrix_dimensions.name: Provenance Limits
matrix_dimensions.description: Quote and locator per substantive value; not reported, unavailable, conflicting and not applicable distinct.

matrix_dimensions.name: Open Science
matrix_dimensions.description: Code/data access, license, retractions/corrections, funding/COI; these are charted, not automatic quality cutoffs.
